case_evidence.description: Frozen public eyetrajectoriespy==1.2.0 src/eyetrajectoriespy/plotting.py::plot_fpca_spectrum_uncertainty, matched by optional native strict scientific artist data.

Native real matched-bootstrap spectrum uncertainty with an FPC reference fit, retained component eigenvalues, individual and cumulative explained-variance ratios and finite native bootstrap uncertainty bounds for exactly three allowed metrics. Scope 'family' maps to source title familywise; scope 'component' maps to component-wise. No Python Axes runtime identity, injected axes, or general duck-typed Python objects.

Reference value at each FPC is original full-sample eigenvalue, ratio or cumulative ratio, not substituted bootstrap rank; source x=1..n, y=estimate, asymmetric lower/upper uncertainty yerr, marker 'o', capsize 3 and exact metric ylabel. Studentized component or within-metric familywise calibration remains the existing native estimator result; source plot does not clip data. Direct frozen Python 1.2 public Matplotlib ErrorbarContainer line data/source text comparisons and real native 20-replicate fitted spectrum uncertainty tests committed, no observed green exact-head CI.

Strict rejects wrong scientific class, unknown metric/scope, malformed length, nonfinite endpoints, interval bounds not containing estimates and nonlogical mode. Python error types and Matplotlib Axes manipulation are not copied.

Python Matplotlib Axes with one errorbar container and explicit labeled spectrum metric/title. Native strict R record contains component locations, estimate, asymmetric yerr, lower/upper bounds, marker, capsize and source scope; original R four-column source summary and R rendering are preserved. Runtime Matplotlib class and pixel identity remain different.

Descriptive matched-bootstrap uncertainty for eigenspace-indexed eigenvalues or explained-variance ratios, with cumulative variance in descending fitted eigenvalue rank and separate familywise versus component-wise studentized calibration.
